title: Career roadmap · High-Performance Director
summary: Build from sports-science expertise into multidisciplinary performance leadership by combining biomechanics, physiology, psychology, analytics, athlete pathways, coaching systems and organisational management.

facts.Current degree: Ph.D. - Physical Education, Sports Science & Yoga
facts.Timeline assumption: This roadmap assumes a 2026 Ph.D. start and an India-first pathway toward leadership of a national/state high-performance programme, federation, academy or sports institute. The Ph.D. provides scientific credibility, but director-level roles also require substantial experience managing athletes, coaches, sports scientists, budgets, performance systems and stakeholders. SAI's current National Centres of Excellence explicitly combine biomechanics, physiology, psychology, performance analysis, nutrition, physiotherapy and strength and conditioning within their sports-science support model. Sports Authority of India

horizons.question: What can I enter now?
horizons.output: Complete the Ph.D., establish a sports-science specialisation and gain applied experience in athlete testing, monitoring and performance programmes.

horizons.question: How should I specialise?
horizons.output: Become a senior performance scientist/manager and develop expertise in multidisciplinary high-performance systems.

horizons.question: How should I evolve?
horizons.output: Lead performance teams, athlete pathways, major programmes and performance investments with measurable results.

horizons.question: How can I remain relevant?
horizons.output: Direct an elite-performance system, shape national/state strategy and build sustainable pipelines from talent identification to international competition.

Career progression

Ph.D. Researcher → Sports Scientist/Performance Scientist
2030–2035: Senior Performance Scientist → Performance Manager
2035–2040: High-Performance Manager → Performance Programme Director / Technical Director
2040–2046: High-Performance Director → National Performance Director → Sports Performance Executive
Ph.D. research routes

At director level, the job is no longer primarily about conducting tests or publishing papers. It is about creating an effective performance system: selecting the right athletes, supporting coaches, integrating sports scientists, allocating resources, managing performance targets, protecting athlete welfare and evaluating whether investment produces results. SAI's current NCOE model is a useful benchmark because it explicitly combines specialised training, sports-science support and High Performance Directors within an elite-athlete environment. Sports Authority of India
